Federal elections were held in Germany on 6 November 1932. [ 1 ] The Nazi Party saw its vote share fall by four percentage points from the July 1932 election , while there were slight increases for the Communist Party of Germany and the national conservative German National People's Party . The results were a great disappointment for the Nazis, who lost 34 seats and again failed to form a coalition government in the Reichstag . These elections were the last that were free and fair before the Nazis seized power the following year, although another relatively contested election would be held four months later.
